plugins.name: japanlaw
plugins.description: Read, cite and explain Japanese statutes from the text itself: the Japanese as published, the Ministry of Justice's English where there is one, and labelled machine translation where there is not. Six read-only tools from japanlaw.org's MCP server, and a skill that teaches how a Japanese provision is cited and which English may be quoted.
